ops.body: - [loop] Explore's town-page Escape (`(tabs)/explore.tsx`'s `out()`) and the area card's (`AtlasCard`, `covered` is only the planner) still act under a Modal: with the recording bar's editor up after its photo (decision 0240), on a town's page Escape leaves the page on keydown and closes the editor on keyup; on a wide browser, where the card is a side panel and the bar stays up, it closes the card too. Gate both on `modalsUp` as the planner and the outing page now are (fix planner-edit's review, auditor F3, low; older than the fix).

- [loop] On the web, Tab sent while a Modal over the walk planner is still sliding in (the note page; react-native-web turns its trap on only at `onShow`) leaves the Modal for the planner beneath: the planner's `useFocusTrap` stands aside as soon as an `aria-modal` is drawn (`lib/focus`'s `modalAbove`). Count a Modal as above only once its trap is on, or move focus into it at once (fix planner-edit's review, auditor F4, low; the `planner` journey waits 800 ms before its Tab check).

- [loop] The walk planner's capture toast ("Voice memo saved here", "Note saved here", "Too short, not kept") has no timer and no close (`PlannerCapture`'s `said` is only ever replaced), sits at `bottom: 140` over Start and "Suggest different routes" and takes their taps; and the capture stack covers the planner's own lines and Start's right end (the outing page keeps its sheet left of the stack, `outing.md`). Time the toast out above the stack and keep the body clear of the column (fix planner-edit's review, ux U1 and U4, auditor F5, low; older than the fix, WP23).

argv: To verify: Escape in the note page over the walk planner
Settled by fix planner-edit: the planner and the outing page close on Escape only with no Modal over them (decision 0240's addendum)
